image.alt: Teamwork and Strategy — Gilli Danda

slides.title: A Winning Strategy

example.problem: How can I become a better gilli danda player?
example.solution: Practice your tap to control where the gilli goes. Build speed by running daily. Watch where fielders stand and hit away from them. Play with friends more experienced than you.

slides.inSimpleWords: Practice beats talent when talent doesn't practice.

slides.title: Why This Game Matters
slides.storyContext: As the sun sets, Ravi tells Arjun: 'This game connects us to our grandparents and their grandparents. It's part of who we are as Indians.'

points.label: Cultural treasure
points.text: Gilli danda is part of Indian heritage, played across villages for millennia

points.label: Life lesson
points.text: Sometimes the simplest games teach the deepest lessons about courage, skill, and community

slides.inSimpleWords: Games carry culture and history.

image.alt: Why This Game Matters — Gilli Danda

slides.title: Cricket's Ancestor

points.label: Did you know?
points.text: Gilli danda is believed to be an ancestor of the game cricket

points.label: The connection
points.text: Both use a bat and ball (or stick), both require running and strategy, both bring communities together

slides.inSimpleWords: From ancient sticks to modern sports.

slides.title: Learning Sportsmanship

example.problem: What lessons about fair play does gilli danda teach?
example.solution: Respect the rules even when no adult is watching. Celebrate your friends' good plays. Accept losing with dignity. Remember: the game itself is the real victory.

slides.inSimpleWords: Fair play builds real friendships.

slides.title: Play and Learn
slides.storyContext: Arjun challenges his friends to play. They form teams. They laugh. They celebrate. They build memories under the village sky.

points.label: Your turn
points.text: Learn gilli danda or another traditional game. Play with friends. Feel the connection to your heritage

slides.inSimpleWords: Share games, build friendship.

image.alt: Play and Learn — Gilli Danda

slides.title: Teach Someone Else

points.label: Challenge
points.text: Find a friend or younger sibling who doesn't know gilli danda. Teach them the game like Ravi taught Arjun.

points.label: What you'll learn
points.text: How to explain clearly, patience in teaching, and joy in sharing culture

slides.inSimpleWords: Teaching others makes you a leader.

slides.title: The Physics of the Game

points.label: Angle matters
points.text: How you tap the gilli affects its flight path and height

points.label: Power matters
points.text: The harder you swing the danda, the farther the gilli travels

points.label: Timing matters
points.text: Hitting the gilli at the right moment as it comes down is key

slides.inSimpleWords: Science and skill work together.

slides.title: Reading Your Opponents

example.problem: How do good gilli danda players get even better?
example.solution: By watching how their opponents hit (high, low, left, right) and fielding accordingly. The best players study the game, not just play it.

slides.inSimpleWords: Observation sharpens your game sense.

slides.title: Sunset Wisdom
slides.storyContext: As the game ends, Ravi and Arjun sit together. They realize: the game isn't just about winning. It's about playing together, laughing, and making memories.
slides.inSimpleWords: Games are about joy, not just winning.

image.alt: Sunset Wisdom — Gilli Danda

slides.title: Traditional Games Around India

points.label: North India
points.text: Gilli danda, kabaddi, kho-kho

points.label: South India
points.text: Pallankuzhi, kabaddi, silambam

points.label: All bring
points.text: Friendship, fitness, fun, and cultural pride

slides.inSimpleWords: Every region has its own treasured game.

slides.title: How Gilli Danda Builds Fitness

points.label: Speed training
points.text: Running back and forth builds leg strength and stamina

points.label: Hand-eye coordination
points.text: Tapping and hitting the gilli improves reflexes

points.label: Agility
points.text: Quick direction changes while running develop balance and control

slides.inSimpleWords: Village games were ancient fitness.

slides.title: Create Your Own Variation

points.label: Challenge
points.text: With your friends, invent a new rule or variation of gilli danda. What would make it more fun or harder?

points.label: Benefits
points.text: Creativity, teamwork, and ownership of your own traditions

slides.inSimpleWords: Innovation keeps games alive.

slides.title: Gilli Danda Teaches Us
slides.storyContext: A simple game with two sticks teaches skill, courage, strategy, and community. It reminds us that the best treasures are time with friends.
slides.inSimpleWords: Traditional games are forever precious.

image.alt: Gilli Danda Teaches Us — Gilli Danda

slides.title: New Words Learned
slides.storyContext: Gilli (small stick), danda (larger stick), heritage (cultural inheritance), strategy (game plan), traditional (passed down through time).

points.label: Word bank
points.text: gilli, danda, heritage, tradition, strategy, community

slides.inSimpleWords: Words that celebrate our culture.

image.alt: New Words Learned — Gilli Danda

slides.title: Why Games Matter Beyond Fun

example.problem: Is there more to gilli danda than just entertainment?
example.solution: Games teach us life skills: how to handle losing, how to work as a team, how to follow rules, and how to respect others. Gilli danda builds character, not just muscles.

slides.inSimpleWords: Games are teachers in disguise.

slides.title: Connection to Modern Sports

points.label: Like baseball
points.text: You hit something and run while others try to catch you or stop you

points.label: Like cricket
points.text: You use a bat, run between bases, and score points

points.label: The difference
points.text: Gilli danda needs almost no equipment—just two sticks and open space

slides.inSimpleWords: Simple games inspire modern sports.

slides.title: Start a Gilli Danda Club

points.label: Step 1
points.text: Find or make two sticks that work as gilli and danda

points.label: Step 2
points.text: Find an open space and invite friends to play

points.label: Step 3
points.text: Document your game (photos or video) and share your heritage with others

slides.inSimpleWords: You can keep traditions alive.

slides.title: How Outdoor Games Shape Character

points.label: Risk-taking
points.text: Running in gilli danda teaches you to take calculated risks and trust your abilities

points.label: Resilience
points.text: You'll make mistakes, get caught, or miss. Learning to bounce back is essential

points.label: Social bonds
points.text: Games build friendships through shared challenge and celebration

slides.inSimpleWords: Play shapes who we become.

slides.title: Leadership Through Games

example.problem: What does a good gilli danda captain do?
example.solution: They encourage teammates, spot each player's strengths, make fair decisions, and play with integrity. These are the same qualities of leaders in any field.

slides.inSimpleWords: Games reveal your leadership style.
